# Green Door

> > Green Door is an informational resource about Modafinil and wakefulness medications for managing sleep disorders and cognitive performance.

Green Door provides evidence-based information about Modafinil and other wakefulness-promoting agents used to treat conditions like narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnea, and shift work sleep disorder. The site aggregates patient experiences, clinical insights, and practical guidance for individuals considering or using these medications.

## Key Topics

- Modafinil
- Wakefulness medication
- Narcolepsy
- Obstructive sleep apnea
- Shift work sleep disorder
- Sleep disorders
- Cognitive performance
- Drug tolerance
- Side effects
- Patient experiences
- Modafinil effects

## About Modafinil

- [Green Door – Smarter Thinking Starts Here](https://www.greendoor.org): Homepage introducing Modafinil and wakefulness medication for sleep disorders
